notes.title: G&G “Goblin Life”
notes.content:
The objective of G&G “Goblin Life” is to explore the magical world of the Goblins and become part of their society. The more you explore and engage, the higher your completion percentage of the game grows. Your progression is represented with the increasing gift collection in your Player Treehouse. Increase your citizenship in G&G by:

[list]
[*] Completing the first part of G&G “Story Mode”
[*] Then exploring the “Open World Mode” and engaging in Goblin Life activities like river rafting, playing darts, or skipping stones in the river.
[*] Discover magical items throughout the forest, and these goblin gifts show up in your Player Treehouse.
[*] Goblins love their brews. Discover various brew recipes throughout the forest, with ingredients that you can collect or harvest. Farm and harvest crops to concoct brews and receive goblin gifts for your new home!
[/list]

Be sure to check out the 1.2 point update, released today.

notes.title: G&G Point Release 1.2
notes.content:
Since the launch of Gnomes & Goblins, our #1 focus has been to improve performance and enable as many people as possible to experience our game. Our new optimizations have enabled us to improve the visual quality on our High, Medium and Low graphics settings, as well as to include some new gameplay features!

First up is something we know many of you have asked for: we are excited to announce that G&G can now be played with a teleport style of traversal! This is an experimental feature, but we hope it will allow those who are sensitive to sim-sickness to play through the game at a greater level of comfort. Our teleport is a flat-ground-style arc teleport, so it won’t allow jumping between floors of tree interiors. For that, you will still need to use your other tools. Switch to the Teleport traversal in the Options Menu to try it out.

To enable the best experience possible, we recommend closing down all other unrelated applications before launching G&G. We have found during our performance testing that leaving many tabs open in web browsers can be detrimental to G&G’s performance and can contribute to sim-sickness.

We also wanted to give a look behind the curtain at all the beautiful animation and art that our developers have created during G&G’s production. To that end, we have added Art and Animation Galleries that can be accessed from the Quest Log after finishing “Story Mode.” Just turn the page and walk into the Magic Portal! So much love and care went into every aspect of this game, and we are thrilled to give you a closer look at some of that work.

Stay tuned for more.

Thank you,

The Wevr Team


[h2]Changes[/h2]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Further improvements to graphics settings to enhance performance
[*] Further improvements to particle systems’ performance
[*] Reduced excessive VRAM usage to improve texture streaming
[*] Reduced frequency and size of hitches caused by garbage collection
[*] Reduced lightmap memory usage by forcing all LODs to share lightmaps
[*] Fixed lightmap popping in LOW and MED graphics settings
[*] Reduce muddiness of textures on LOW introduced in 1.1
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Teleport Traversal option accessible via options menu (Experimental!)[/b]
[*] [b]Added Art & Animation Galleries accessible via Quest Log portal after reaching Goblin Life[/b]
[*] Added hint books to Goblin Life
[*] Fixed light pop on characters
[*] Removed some props from where the bucket spawns
[*] Fix audio being lost when game doesn’t have focus
[*] Fix audio being lost after Gnome Maze
[*] Converted some achievements to incremental achievements so their progress is tracked
[/list]

notes.title: G&G Point Release 1.1
notes.content:
Last month, we released our long-awaited title Gnomes & Goblins. We’ve been thrilled to watch Wevr fans and VR newbies alike express their immediate obsession with Buddy the Goblin and his magical forest. Your positive response to G&G warms our hearts immensely, as we developed this project with a ton of love. 

We’ve also heard back from many users who have experienced a range of performance issues. Please know that we hear you and we have spent the past month working hard to optimize G&G for all users. In particular, we’ve noted performance issues that have impacted Oculus users and want to express our commitment to improving G&G’s playback on the Rift S. 

Today, we are releasing an update for G&G that should noticeably improve performance. For a detailed list of the new revisions, please see below. If after installing this patch, you continue to experience performance issues, we recommend adjusting your system’s graphics settings lower (found in the options menu). For those with Oculus headsets, turning off ASW can help, as well.

The high-fidelity tech we developed for G&G does require high GPU and CPU performance to maintain the fantastical visuals and immersive quality. That said, our performance improvements have enabled us to revise G&G’s minimum and recommended specs:

[b]MINIMUM SPEC:[/b]
[i]Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10
Processor: i7-6700K or equivalent
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1080 or equivalent
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 35 GB available space
[/i]
[b]RECOMMENDED SPEC:[/b]
[i]Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10
Processor: i7-9700K or equivalent
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 2080 or equivalent
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 35 GB available space[/i]

Other than performance concerns, we have also fielded questions about the length of G&G as a whole. 

G&G offers two gameplay modes. The initial onboarding and narrative “Story” mode can be completed in around an hour. The challenging, exploratory scavenger hunt  “Goblin Life” open-world mode, on the other hand, may take more than five hours for core VR users to complete. We purposefully designed “Goblin Life” mode to minimize breaks in immersion caused by load screens, excessive instruction, and overly specific goal-oriented action. This phase of G&G isn’t about earning points, racking up kills, or beating your friends—it’s about collecting, harvesting, and enjoying the underlying magic that imbues G&G. 

We look forward to hearing more about your G&G experiences and we’ll take note of all the feedback we receive. We are still working on additional performance enhancements, but we’ve made enough gains over the past month that we wanted to ship this update immediately while we continue working on the next patch. We’re an indie studio and we are committed to the future of G&G and our fans. Our G&G devs look forward to connecting with you personally as we continue to improve G&G. Stay tuned for more. 

Thank you,

The Wevr Team

[h2]ADDITIONAL UPDATES[/h2]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed shearing issue on Oculus Rift S and other Oculus headsets
[*] Set default graphic settings to Medium 
[*] Optimization pass on all materials to improve performance
[*] Adjust texture streaming to help performance
[*] Improve performance of ambient particle systems
[*] Improve scalability settings in graphics levels to improve performance
[*] Turn off some material effects on Low graphics to improve performance
[*] Made improvements to streaming levels to reduce hitching while locomoting
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash caused by encountering certain Goblin and Gnome factions
[*] Fixed crash when entering Pub after crafting Pumpkin Peach brew
[*] Added a fix for invisible ladder in Gnome Maze caused by corrupted save file
[*] Fixed water collision not working reliably
[*] Fixed skipping stones not skipping on water surface
[*] Adjusted game completion percentage calculations to better reflect player progress
[*] Made Magic-Eye and Magic-Bell teleport to your belt at start of Goblin Life
[*] Adjusted belt profile options to bring belt more forward and easier to see
[/list]

notes.title: Clues for your adventure!
notes.content:
G&G is a multi-hour adventure simulation VR game that begins in story mode as a guided journey, and unfolds into an open world mode collection and crafting game.

Here are some clues to kickstart your “scavenger-hunt” in open world mode:
After completing the "Lantern Release," you start "Goblin Life", the open world mode. Keep the Magic Bell and the Magic Eye on your waist belt.
Use the Magic Eye device to teleport around the forest. Use the Magic Bell to summon Fairies, then grab and shake them.
Locate hidden seed packs throughout the forest to unlock more seed silos in the Farm. Plant crops and grow your harvest over time. 
In the Brewery, follow the recipes in the Magic Book. Put the recipe ingredients in the little cart next to the Magic Book and ring the bell to start brewing. Watch clip.
As you discover magical artifacts throughout the forest, your inventory grows in your Player Treehouse. Shake the Hint Fairy in the Player Treehouse to see all the remaining collectibles.

We are committed to keep improving the game experience and expanding the world of G&G. Please share your feedback. We are here and listening.

Download the game and welcome to the world of G&G!

For more information sign up at gnomesandgoblins.com.
